I3_resolverAndChoiceEngine.what: review M1: the choice engine takes the template config through templateConfigFor; one engine instance per table (shipped = null, v21.b1). OFFERING and RESOLUTION use the engine of the ruleset table everywhere: own choices, offered lists, win-condition fill, effective choices, merge (template -> overlays -> choices), view config, indicators. PLAN VALIDITY is ruleset-independent and stated: a plan is valid iff its structure is valid and planProblems is empty under the shipped config OR under at least one registered table (union; when all fail the shipped errors are returned). So no saved plan, binding or planHash changes, and a plan saved in one mode never becomes unresolvable in the other (an explicit choice that is a no-op under the other config is applied as a no-op). legacy and std inputs: unchanged. resolveTactic takes opts.templateBalance (absent => byte-identical behaviour); the meta tacticName / playbookName of a balanced classic template come from TEMPLATE_COPY under that table (review M5: results under career.v21 show the v21 name), otherwise unchanged. Review round 2: (M1) the SAME union function is used by createTacticPlan (tacticPlan.js:225) and by the resolver re-validation (tacticResolver.js:119), computed over the table variants of the same mapping instance (planted-mapping gates keep working); example pinned in S4: classic.m7 phases.early.focusLane=top is a no-op under the shipped config (tacticChoiceMapping.js:266-267) and offered under v21.b1, and resolves in both directions. (minor 5) the table engine is also used by keptUnofferedChoices (tacticBookOptions.js:271, at match start useLocalServer.js:237), offeredChoicesOnly and the AI coach tacticBookOptions call (aiCoach.js:66; the ruleset table is passed through redCoachBinding). (minor 6) caps and floors of the mapping (tplConfig sources std and classic.m2, tacticChoiceMapping.js:89, 99) are neutral mapping constants and never go through templateConfigFor. (M4) measured exclusions and replication withdrawals get an optional templateBalance key: a row with templateBalance X applies only under table X; a row without the key applies everywhere (today's behaviour, so the existing rows measured on the shipped m3 / m7 / m8 configs keep withholding under v21.b1 conservatively until the pre-freeze measurement re-decides them for v21.b1, Owner 2026-10-23 evidence isolation). Meta under a table: tacticName / playbookName of a template with a TEMPLATE_COPY entry come from the copy (binding input: the templateId; legacy input: the classic template of its tacticId); otherwise unchanged
